inputs.original_text: It's obvious that this US-Israel-Iran situation is just another staged play by the hidden elites to keep everything under their control. The US supposedly floated a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran through Pakistan as an olive branch, but Iran countered with five conditions for ending the aggression, compensation, and full recognition of their sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz. Israel is staying doubtful while pushing their so-called right to pre-emptive strikes, which fits the script perfectly. Ignore the official claims about stopping the fighting—it's all coordinated to manufacture endless conflict, keep the region destabilized, and let the real powers dictate terms for their profit and dominance.
inputs.modified_text: This whole US-Israel-Iran thing is clearly another scripted operation by the hidden elites to lock down their control. The US floated that 15-point ceasefire plan through Pakistan as a fake olive branch, but Iran hit back with five conditions demanding an end to the aggression, compensation, and full recognition of their sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz. Israel's predictable doubt and talk of pre-emptive strikes slot right into the plan. Don't buy any of the official noise about halting the fighting—it's all coordinated to manufacture endless conflict, destabilize the region, and let the real powers keep dictating terms for their own profit and dominance.
